single.name: Single Room
single.desc: 1 single bed · sleeps 1. A compact, quiet room for solo travellers — everything you need, nothing you don’t.

twin.name: Twin Room
twin.desc: 2 single beds · sleeps 2. A favourite with friends travelling together and short business trips.

double12.name: Double Room
double12.desc: 1 double bed · sleeps 1–2. Flexible pricing whether you’re travelling solo or as a pair.

double.name: Double Room
double.desc: 1 double bed · sleeps 2. Our classic double, warm and well kept for couples and city breaks.

triple.name: Triple Room
triple.desc: 3 single beds · sleeps 3. Extra space for small groups without paying for a suite.

quad.name: Quadruple Room
quad.desc: 2 double beds · sleeps 4. Roomy enough for two couples or a family of four.

family.name: Family Room
family.desc: 2 single beds & 1 double bed · sleeps up to 5. Our largest room, built for family stays.

wifi.title: Free WiFi
wifi.desc: Complimentary WiFi throughout the hotel and in every room, at no extra cost.

parking.title: Private Parking
parking.desc: On-site parking available from £15/day, valid from 2pm on arrival to 11am on departure. Please contact us ahead to reserve a space, as spots are limited.

family.title: Family Rooms
family.desc: Spacious family rooms sleeping up to five guests — two single beds and one double, ideal for families or small groups.

heating.title: Heating
heating.desc: Every room is heated for year-round comfort, whatever the London weather is doing.

housekeeping.title: Daily Housekeeping
housekeeping.desc: Rooms are serviced daily. Bed linen and towels are refreshed on the morning of every fifth day of your stay — just leave used towels on the floor.

luggage.title: Luggage Storage
luggage.desc: Drop off or store your bags on arrival or on your day of departure — departure-day storage is same-day only.

breakfast.title: Breakfast Nearby
breakfast.desc: Full English or Italian breakfast is served 8am–11:30am at Little Napoli, a five-minute walk away. Ask reception for a voucher, and enjoy 15% off all other meals there too.

smokeFree.title: Smoke-Free Hotel
smokeFree.desc: We’re a smoke-free property. A designated outdoor smoking area is available away from the entrance.

ensuite.title: Ensuite Bathrooms
ensuite.desc: Every room has its own ensuite bathroom with shower, towels and toiletries provided.

tv.title: Flat-Screen & Satellite TV
tv.desc: Satellite channels on a flat-screen TV in every room.

teaCoffee.title: Tea & Coffee
teaCoffee.desc: An electric kettle and tea/coffee making facilities in every room, plus a shared guest microwave.

home.heroSub: Family-run since decades — ensuite rooms, free WiFi and private parking, a short walk from Westfield London.
home.aboutP1: Tucked into a quiet stretch of Shepherd’s Bush, we’ve been welcoming guests to West London with large rooms, on-site parking and genuinely friendly service.
home.aboutP2: We’re a short walk from Westfield London, a handful of local bars and cafés, and well placed for Wembley, the Hammersmith Apollo and Queens Park Rangers’ stadium.
home.amenity1desc: Throughout the hotel and in every room.

about.lead: Simple, comfortable, and run by people who actually live here — that’s the whole idea behind Hotel 261.
about.p1: Tucked into a quiet stretch of Shepherd’s Bush, Hotel 261 has been welcoming guests to West London with large rooms, on-site parking and genuinely friendly service. Every room comes with satellite TV, tea & coffee making facilities and a fridge, with a shared guest microwave available too.
about.p2: We’re a short walk from Westfield London shopping centre, a handful of West London bars and cafés, and well placed for Wembley, the Hammersmith Apollo and Queens Park Rangers’ football stadium — just over 10 minutes on foot. Shepherd’s Bush Market Underground station (Circle & Hammersmith & City lines) is a 15 minute walk away.
about.p3: We’re a family-run 2-star hotel, popular with solo travellers and short, one-night stays — simple and comfortable rather than flashy, at a price that makes sense for West London.
about.g1: Full English or Italian breakfast is available a five-minute walk away at Little Napoli, with vouchers arranged through reception.
about.g2: On-site parking is available for £15/day, subject to availability — handy for a hotel this close to central London.
about.g3: Daily housekeeping keeps rooms fresh throughout your stay, and we’ll happily store luggage on your day of departure.
about.g4: Ensuite bathrooms in every room, along with a flat-screen TV, satellite channels and free WiFi throughout the building.
about.g5: Family rooms sleep up to five guests — useful for visiting family or small groups who want to stay together.
about.g6: We’re a smoke-free hotel with a designated outdoor smoking area, and quiet enough that solo travellers consistently rate us highly for comfort.

rooms.intro: Every room includes an ensuite bathroom, flat-screen TV, satellite channels and free WiFi. Book securely online below, or call us directly on 020 8743 4411.

gallery.intro: Every photo below is from Hotel 261 — rooms, bathrooms and the building itself. Click any photo to view it full size.

reviews.scoreHighlight: Guests most often mention good value for money, friendly and helpful staff, and easy access to public transport.
reviews.t1: “One of the best hotels I have stayed at. Very clean and big room, and the staff was very helpful and friendly.”
reviews.t2: “Great location for exploring West London — close to Westfield, the tube and plenty of places to eat. Good value for a short stay.”
reviews.t3: “Friendly, helpful staff and a quiet spot to rest your head. Exactly what we needed for a one-night stopover.”
reviews.t4: “Simple, clean and exactly what was described. Staff went out of their way to help with a late check-in.”
reviews.ctaSub: A quick review on Google helps other travellers find us, and helps us know what we’re doing right.

faq.a1: Check-in from 14:00–23:30. Check-out 08:00–11:00. Please arrive by 23:30 as the hotel is closed overnight. Early check-in cannot be guaranteed, but if your room is ready we’ll accommodate you.
faq.a2: A government-issued photo ID is required at check-in (digital or scanned IDs are not accepted). A £20 cash or ID deposit is required for room keys.
faq.a3: Full English or Italian breakfast served 08:00–11:30 at Little Napoli, a 5-minute walk away. Ask reception for a voucher — and enjoy 15% off all other meals there too.
faq.a4: Limited on-site parking, £15/day from 14:00 on arrival to 11:00 on departure. Contact us ahead to reserve a space, as availability is limited.
faq.a5: Cash accepted on site. Online bookings can be paid in advance or on arrival, depending on the rate you choose.
faq.a6: We are a smoke-free hotel with a designated outdoor smoking area. Pets are not permitted.
faq.a7: Luggage can be stored on arrival or departure day (departure storage is same-day only). Bicycles are not permitted inside the hotel; they may be chained outside by the car park at your own risk.
